mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit prostaglandin-mediated renal potassium excretion and reduce aldosterone secretion, increasing serum potassium levels especially in patients with renal impairment or on ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid concurrent use in high-risk patients; consider alternative analgesics; counsel on dietary potassium restriction if potassium supplementation is necessary.
